strings.name: Abigail Johnson
strings.summary: Abigail Johnson is an American financial executive who studied art history and business before joining her family’s Fidelity Investments in 1988. She moved from securities analysis and fund management to leading several businesses, becoming CEO in 2014 and chairman in 2016. During her tenure Fidelity expanded retirement savings, wealth management and digital asset services; these are collective institutional achievements.

strings.highlights.h1.title: Leadership across businesses
strings.highlights.h1.text: Progressed from investment analysis and fund management to leadership in asset management, retirement and institutional services.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Fidelity succession
strings.highlights.h2.text: Became CEO in 2014 and chairman in 2016, leading the financial services company founded by her family.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Became chairman
strings.timeline.t1.text: Added Fidelity’s chairmanship to her CEO role, taking broader governance and strategic responsibility.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Became CEO
strings.timeline.t2.text: Succeeded her father as Fidelity CEO after a long career within the family company.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Financial services president
strings.timeline.t3.text: Became president of Fidelity Financial Services, broadening oversight of brokerage, retirement and institutional businesses.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Customer business leadership
strings.timeline.t4.text: Began leading Personal, Workplace and Institutional Services, expanding beyond investment management.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Asset management leadership
strings.timeline.t5.text: Became president of Fidelity’s asset management business, moving further into organizational leadership.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Joined Fidelity
strings.timeline.t6.text: Joined Fidelity after her Harvard MBA, beginning in equity research analysis.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Art history degree
strings.timeline.t7.text: Completed an art history bachelor’s degree at William Smith College of Hobart and William Smith Colleges.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Boston childhood
strings.timeline.t8.text: Born in Boston; Fidelity, founded by her grandfather, later became the focus of her career.
